definitions: Juicy Jaii is an American rapper, singer, and songwriter from Memphis, Tennessee.
Juicy Jaii is a member of the hip hop group Three 6 Mafia.
examples: Juicy Jaii released his debut album in 2002.
The concert featured a special performance by Juicy Jaii.
Juicy Jaii's music often incorporates elements of horrorcore and crunk.
